title: InitNO: Boosting Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Initial Noise Optimization
tldr_zh: 首步注意力分划分有效/无效噪声区，带 KL 高斯约束的仿射优化把初值推进有效区；SD1.4 用户研究 63.33%，耗时 2.3×
tldr_en: Scores initial noise by first-step cross/self-attention, optimizes an affine reparameterization with KL-to-Gaussian penalty into the valid region; SD1.4, 2.3x slower.
key_numbers: User study (12 raters x 20 questions): InitNO 63.33% vs Attend-and-Excite 14.17% vs SD 4.17% (Table 1)
Inference time on V100: SD 8.34 s -> InitNO 18.93 s per 512px image (Sec. 5.3)
Thresholds tau_c = 0.2 (cross-attn response), tau_s = 0.3 (self-attn conflict); KL weight lambda_3 = 500 (Sec. 4.1-4.2)
Up to 50 Adam steps x 5 resampling rounds per prompt (Alg. 1)
CLIP image-text / text-text similarity above all baselines on Animal-Animal, Animal-Object, Object-Object (Fig. 7, bar chart only)
Without KL loss the optimized noise visibly leaves N(0,1) in t-SNE and images distort (Fig. 9)
